title: A pinned technician who can no longer take work shows 'No work orders'
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Jenny Wilson" and "Theresa Webb" (neither leading any work order) and "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by Esther Howard):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
  6. Create a second user who can view but not change work orders:
    • Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create custom role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO view only") > turn on Work Orders view, leave Work Orders create and edit off > Save.
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member with an email you can open (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer"), role = the new role, enrolled at this location > Save, then accept the invitation and set a password.
    • Keep this user signed in in a second browser (or a private window) so you can switch between the two users.
  7. As your user, and again as the view-only user, open Work Orders > Board View and pin Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb (pins are per user).
custom_steps:
1. Deactivate Jenny Wilson: Settings > Staff > open Jenny Wilson > set the staff record inactive > Save.
  2. Remove Theresa Webb from this location: Settings > Staff > open Theresa Webb > remove this location from her enrolment > Save.
  3. Open Work Orders.
  4. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  6. Read the pinned Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb columns.
  7. Try to drag the S1-702 card onto Jenny Wilson's column.
  8. In the second browser, as the view-only user, open Work Orders in Board View.
  9. Read the pinned Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb columns.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Both pinned columns are still shown (the pins are kept) and are empty.
  • For your user (who can reassign), each shows "No work orders", not "Drag a work order here to assign it".
  • The card cannot be dropped on Jenny Wilson's column.
  • For the view-only user, both columns also show "No work orders".
  • Afterwards, set Jenny Wilson active again and re-enrol Theresa Webb to restore the data.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R20a, S4-N5, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD footer comment Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026 (active but no longer eligible technicians are treated like inactive). Tech plan 3.13.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R20a: “The empty column of a pinned technician who can no longer be assigned work orders (deactivated, or not enrolled at this location) shows “No work orders” to every user, because nothing can be dropped there (S4-N5).”
  • S4-N5: “Nothing can be dropped onto an inactive technician's column/group (S2-N2, S3-N2).”
